transcript.question: Welcome to Antara. Do you understand that this conversation is strictly confidential, encrypted, and that a clinical report and transcript will be provided only to your therapist before your session, after which your data is erased?
How are you feeling right now as you sit down for this conversation?
transcript.finalAnswer: I am actually feeling completely fine, peaceful, and totally happy! Life is great, really nothing to complain about.

transcript.question: If you tune in to your physical body right this moment, what sensations are present?
transcript.finalAnswer: There is a sharp painful knot in my stomach and my chest feels so constricted I can barely take a full breath.

transcript.question: What is happening around you when that chest constriction and stomach knot appear?
transcript.finalAnswer: Every morning before logging on to work, I get terrible nausea and start shaking. I dread opening my emails or hearing my phone ring.

transcript.question: How have sleep, eating, and basic energy been feeling recently?
transcript.finalAnswer: I haven't had a full night of sleep in weeks. I wake up in cold sweats at 2 AM with panic attacks, and I force myself to eat crackers because food makes me nauseous.

transcript.question: How do you feel in your interactions with family or friends?
transcript.finalAnswer: I put on a bright smile and act like the life of the party because everyone depends on me to be cheerful. Deep down I feel completely hollow and isolated.

transcript.question: What do you hope you and your therapist can explore together?
transcript.finalAnswer: I need help taking off this mask. I want someone to know how exhausted I am of pretending I have it all together.
